name: RC-B10-0533/2026 - Après le § 12 - Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the illegal Türkiye-Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
part_text: 12a. Expresses its concern at the Ukrainian military action in the port of Benghazi and in Libyan waters, which risks a dangerous escalation in the central Mediterranean and further undermines Libya’s fragile stability, sovereignty and territorial integrity, already eroded by Türkiye’s interference in Libya, including through the illegal MoU and the related security and military cooperation arrangements; calls on the Commission, the VP/HR and the Member States to seek clarification regarding these unacceptable incidents, strengthen the security of the EU’s southern flank and its maritime surveillance capacities in the central Mediterranean, and give renewed priority to diplomacy and to achieving a negotiated end to the ongoing war in Ukraine;
